name: Methi
actions: Supports healthy blood sugar in diet
kitchenUse: A teaspoon of seeds soaked overnight and eaten in the morning, or cooked into dal and vegetables.

cautions.note: Not safe in pregnancy in amounts above those in food; its use has been linked to birth defects.

cautions.note: Little is known about amounts above those in food while breastfeeding.

evidence.summary: Studies suggest fenugreek may lower blood sugar in type 2 diabetes, but many were not of high quality. Its effect on breast milk supply is uncertain.
